english.title: Fail to keep animal under control - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[failed to keep an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), under control]_
(B)_[permitted an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..) to foul a footpath or building, namely **(..SPECIFY PLACE..),]_

at Liverpool John Lennon Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 3(16) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationfailed to keep an animal under control OR permitted an animal to foul a footpath or buildingat Liverpool John Lennon Airport

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes: Byelaw 1(3) states that the offence will not be committed by any member of a fire, police or ambulance service acting in the course of their duty or to any emergency vehicle being used by such a person.
